name: Bardessono Hotel and Spa
insider_take: Napa Valley's most sustainable luxury hideaway, where LEED Platinum certification meets world-class wine country sophistication.
whats_special: This eco-luxury pioneer features rooftop gardens, geothermal heating, and reclaimed materials throughout its 62 suites. Located in the heart of Yountville's culinary corridor, you're steps from Thomas Keller's French Laundry and Bouchon Bistro. The spa uses organic, locally-sourced treatments, and each suite has a private courtyard with living green walls.
pro_tip: Book the spa's signature "Vineyard Stone" massage using heated stones from local Napa Valley quarries, and time it before sunset for the most relaxing experience.
dont_miss: The hotel's Lucy Restaurant serves farm-to-table cuisine featuring ingredients from their on-site organic garden. Take advantage of the complimentary Audi house car service within Yountville, and explore the nearby Napa Valley Museum just two blocks away showcasing local wine and art history.
pros: LEED Platinum certified eco-luxury resort with sustainable design
Prime Napa Valley location in charming Yountville
Award-winning spa with organic treatments and wellness programs
Spacious suites with private terraces and modern amenities
